input.quote: 20. INDEMNIFICATION 20.1 Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
input.rationale: Section 20 contains a single, one-way Customer indemnity covering "every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services", and there is no Vendor indemnity anywhere in the Agreement (searches for indemnity/infringement return only §§ 9.3, 19.4-19.5, 21.3 and 29.2, none of which create a Vendor indemnity). That is walk-away territory: no Vendor IP indemnity plus a one-way Customer indemnity for Vendor's services. We therefore insert the preferred Vendor defence and indemnity (IP infringement of the Services or Deliverables, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused unauthorized access to Customer Data, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with a notice/control/cooperation procedure, and narrow our indemnity to Customer-provided content and our breach of Applicable Law. Note also that § 9.3 cross-refers to "the remedies required by Section 20.5", which does not exist; if Vendor prefers the fallback (IP indemnity with customary modification/combination/specification exclusions, procure-modify-replace-refund remedies and a 3x annual fee super-cap), that dangling reference should be filled at the same time.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

proposal.summary: Add Vendor defence/indemnity for IP, legal breach, data breach and wilful misconduct with claim procedure, and narrow Customer's indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 20 currently gives Vendor a one-way indemnity for "every claim" relating to our use of the Services and contains no Vendor indemnity at all. We have added the Vendor defence and indemnity for IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct with a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, and narrowed our indemnity to Customer-provided content and our breach of law.

ops.oldText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from every claim relating in any way to Customer's use of the Services.
ops.newText: Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Vendor from third-party claims to the extent arising out of Customer-provided content or Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

ops.text: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs, and expenses, to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or any Deliverable infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party notice of the claim, the indemnifying Party shall control the defence, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation.
